**SOKOTO ELECTRICITY DISTRIBUTION COMPANY**

12 April 2026

Gwarzo Block Industry  
Account Number: SYN-1005

Dear Customer,

Revenue Protection referred your account for review following a routine feeder loss analysis.

We have examined your billing for the twelve months to March 2026. All twelve invoices were based on actual meter reads with no estimates. The read deltas match the billed kilowatt-hours exactly each month, the rate applied (NGN225 per kWh for C1 Band A) is correct, and the meter register is progressing normally with no stalls or rollovers. We found no unbilled periods, duplicate invoices or rating errors.

However, the review raised questions we cannot resolve from records alone. Your consumption dropped 84.5% in December 2025, from a median of 891 kWh to 138 kWh, and has remained around 140 kWh per month since then. This drop occurred in the same month you commissioned a block moulding machine and a 15HP borehole pump. Our January 2026 visit confirmed eight staff and production six days a week, yet consumption stayed low. The April 2026 audit also noted that the service cable enters through an unsealed junction box, which requires verification.

A field inspection team will visit your premises within ten working days to verify the installation, confirm all connected loads, check for additional meters, and inspect the service entry point and meter seals. Please ensure access to all electrical equipment and meter points during the visit.

If you have questions before the inspection, contact Musa Abdullahi in Customer Care on 080-DISCO-07 or mabdullahi@sokolodisco.ng, reference CASE-05.

Yours faithfully,

**Abubakar Tambuwal**  
Manager, Customer Care
